message.content: Close your eyes now, letting your body feel wonderfully heavy and soft, like a passing cloud drifting across a quiet sky. In your mind, you find yourself in a gentle forest clearing under twinkling stars and a soothing moon. Nearby, Freddie the Fox is curled up on a bed of soft moss, his bushy tail gently moving as he sinks deeper into peaceful sleep. Overhead, Ollie and Olivia, two wise little owls, perch quietly on sturdy branches, their whispers and soft hoots like gentle lullabies in the hushed night. Notice the serenity that wraps around you, just as it cradles Freddie, Ollie, and Olivia, free from worry and open to the sweet stillness of these resting woods. Imagine Freddie dreaming of flickering fireflies in a moonlit meadow, feeling safe and content, just as you do in this restful moment. Ollie and Olivia float in their own dreams of silently gliding through the star-spangled sky, watching over the tranquil forest below with calm assurance. Feel your own body settling even more deeply, each slow breath ushering away any lingering concerns. Your heart feels light, your mind feels calm, and every muscle releases its tension. With every soft inhalation, you drift closer to a serene state, gently guided by the reassuring presence of Freddie, Ollie, and Olivia. Now, let your mind embrace the soothing darkness, letting warmth and peace carry you into restful sleep. In this space, surrender to peaceful dreams tonight

parts.text: Close your eyes now, and let your body feel heavy and soft, like a fluffy cloud. Imagine you are nestled in a cozy forest clearing under a blanket of twinkling stars and a gentle moon.

Nearby, you see Freddie the Fox, curled up on a soft bed of moss, his bushy tail twitching ever so slightly as he drifts into peaceful sleep. Ollie and Olivia, the wise little owls, perch on branches above, their soft hoots like gentle lullabies.
Feel the calm of the night surrounding you, just like it surrounds Freddie, Ollie, and Olivia. There is nothing to worry about, only the quiet beauty of the sleeping forest.
Imagine Freddie dreaming sweet dreams of chasing fireflies in a meadow bathed in moonlight. He feels happy and safe, just like you do now.
Ollie and Olivia dream of soaring silently through the starry sky, watching over the peaceful forest below. They feel calm and content, their gentle presence a comfort to all.
As you watch Freddie, Ollie, and Olivia sleep so peacefully, feel your own body becoming even more relaxed. Each breath you take carries away any worries, leaving you feeling light and serene.
